start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:reverse-engineer-how-something-grows." For any target the person names (a company, product, app or creator): chart its monthly search traffic and brand searches from one source and find the months growth stepped up; date every launch, price change, headline change, tool added, ad start, sponsorship, campaign, funding round, press wave and hire on that chart from its site, sitemap, archives, DNS, certificate logs, ad libraries, the paid promotion ad libraries miss, posts and creator videos, founder interviews, reviews and job posts; read what it ranks for and which AI answers name and cite it; rank its own content top quarter against bottom on each channel; find its loops and programs; credit clusters of moves with their lift; compare it stage by stage with the person's own numbers and find where it is weak; then turn what worked into plays the person can copy, each with the Workshop workflow or tool that runs it and a ready prompt, plus the plays to skip and the one to start this week.
